prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype", "Select a personality style for your desktop pet. You can customize details later.", "Playful Dog, Calm Cat, Curious Dragon, Mellow Panda"]
1: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Your companion is ready to hangout. Click and drag anytime to move them."]
2: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing the camera with clear background contrast.", "Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple pets.", "Select Clear Front-Facing Photo", "Good lighting ensures crisp 3D pet models."]
3: ["How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?", "Pick a quick premade friend or generate a unique companion from photos."]
4: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "We are crafting your desktop pet's animations and responses. This takes just a moment!", "Did you know? You can double-click your pet to give them treats!"]
5: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Connecting your account ensures your pet and progress are safely backed up in the cloud.", "Signing in prevents pet loss when changing devices or reinstalling."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize their adoption record!", "Pet Name", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
7: ["Welcome Your Companion!", "Your pet should now appear floating on your desktop overlay.", "Don't see your pet? Check your taskbar icon or multi-monitor display settings."]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose quick adoption with instant pet templates or custom pet creation from photos."]
9: ["Creating Your Custom Companion", "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a notification as soon as your pet is ready!"]
